landing.why.copy: Generative AI is fast, but it is fundamentally unverified. In enterprise compliance, guessing is a liability. Assure AI places a deterministic verification engine between your models and your output. It checks math with formal logic, tracks source provenance down to the exact page, and flags every logical gap before a human ever has to look twice.

terms.accuracy: AI systems are probabilistic and can hallucinate. Verification is a filter, not a promise of accuracy. We do not promise that output is flawless, complete, or free from errors. Independently verify critical information.
terms.advice: Assure performs document analysis, verification, and compilation. It does not give legal, financial, or professional advice. Consult qualified professionals before you act on any output.
terms.answers: Assure rewrites your question, can send it to models you connect, and can drop claims that were not in your files. That is a filter, not a promise of accuracy. You check the result before you use it with a client, a paper, or a decision.
terms.as_is: The software is provided "as is", without warranties. We are not liable for damages or other consequences of your use. We do not promise uptime, accuracy, or fitness for a particular job. Any service levels are set only in your signed enterprise agreement.
terms.duty: You are solely responsible for how you use Assure. You agree not to use it for any unlawful, harmful, or abusive purpose.
terms.files: Only upload files you have the right to use. Do not upload privileged, confidential, or sensitive information unless you are authorised to do so. Do not Send health or other sensitive text to a provider that is open to the internet unless you mean to. We are not responsible for uploads that violate your own obligations.
terms.indemnity: You cover losses that arise from your use of Assure. Our total liability is capped at the amount you paid for the service. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or punitive damages.
terms.law: You are responsible for how you use the output. If these terms cannot be enforced in your location, the rest still apply.
terms.lead: How Assure works, what you are responsible for, and what we do not promise.
terms.prohibit: You may not use Assure to generate or promote:

terms.providers: You must also follow the terms of the AI provider you connect. A Send to a connected provider is subject to that provider's rules. Assure does not replace them.
terms.send: Copy keeps the compiled prompt inside your deployment. Send goes only to the provider you connected. Closed to the internet keeps the question in your environment. Open to the internet, it goes to that provider. Assure does not store the text of your questions.
terms.third: We are not liable for decisions made by third parties who rely on the output. Do not share output with others without your own verification.
